processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Fe-Mn-Al-C LDSs (including 30.34 % Mn, 8.93 % Al, and 0.9 % C) were prepared via a vacuum melting furnace.
Steel ingot homogenized at 1200 °C for 2 h.
Hot rolled at 1200–950 °C into slabs with a thickness of 20 mm.
Quenched in water after hot rolling.
Solution treated at 950 °C for 2 h followed by water quenching to room temperature; resulting sample labeled S950 (fine-grained sample, grain size about 8.7 μm).

grain_structure.grain_size_distribution: histogram bars decreasing monotonically from ~43% at ~2 μm out to ~20 μm
grain_structure.texture: random crystallographic orientation, no significant preferred orientation

microstructure_list.dislocation_density: decreased after solution treatment relative to S0; dislocation tangles are observed adjacent to the ATBs

phases_present.morphology: equiaxed grains with well-defined boundaries and abundant annealing twins (straight parallel-sided laths/stripes).
phases_present.texture: random crystallographic orientation distribution, no significant preferred orientation

structures.overall_structure: Single-phase face-centered cubic (FCC) austenitic structure; fully recrystallized equiaxed grains containing abundant annealing twin boundaries (ATBs) and high-angle grain boundaries (HAGBs), with random crystallographic orientation.
